source.name: Brighton & Hove Albion: American Express - Main Club Partner of Brighton & Hove Albion Football Club
source.quote: sponsorship of the men’s, women’s and disability teams’ shirts since 2013, and in 2021 we announced a long term extension
source.note: The club's current partner page, undated. Its partners page (https://www.brightonandhovealbion.com/partner-and-sponsors) lists American Express as 'Stadium Naming Rights and Shirt Partner'.

source.name: Brighton & Hove Albion: Experience Kissimmee announces partnership with Albion
source.note: Archived copy of the club's announcement of 11 June 2024, in which the club calls it 'a new three-year sleeve partnership', so it covers 2024/25 to 2026/27. The club's current partners page (https://www.brightonandhovealbion.com/partner-and-sponsors) still shows Experience Kissimmee under 'Official Sleeve Sponsor'.
source.quote: Experience Kissimmee has secured promotional rights as a sleeve partner on the men’s, women’s and academy shirts

source.name: Brighton & Hove Albion: Pinterest and Brighton & Hove Albion Women partner to bring inspiration to every game
source.quote: will see Pinterest become the first solo sponsor of our women’s team with their branding to appear on the back of our shirts
source.note: The announcement's picture shows the blue-and-white home shirt from behind, with the Pinterest logo under the number, and shorts without a sponsor.

summary: American Express on the front, Experience Kissimmee on the sleeve, and Pinterest - the women's team's first solo sponsor - on the back, under the number. The picture with the club's Pinterest announcement shows no sponsor on the shorts.
